memory_candidates.content: When a curated array check (grep -qF against a canonical fragment's extracted expected text) covers only a filename-glob SUBSET of a broader classification rule, add a 'completeness net' check that enumerates the narrow glob and asserts every match is in the in-scope array OR a recorded exclusion array -- this catches the next registration drift structurally instead of relying on periodic manual measurement. Pattern: Check N in lint-agent-contracts.sh, reusing Check C/G/H/M's existing curated arrays plus two newly-promoted exclusion arrays.

Expanding a curated in-scope array consumed by multiple checks (e.g. OWNERSHIP_IN_SCOPE_RELATIVE_PATHS, read by both Check G's per-file loop and Check I's heartbeat-adoption advisory) can ripple into every OTHER check that reuses the same array, including a separate test suite with its own hand-maintained mirror of that array for fixture-building. Before closing a phase that expands a shared curated array, grep the whole lint script and its test suites for every OTHER consumer of that same array name, not just the one check being targeted.
